messages.subject: canvi data reunió al 3 de Nov - Next meeting date change to Nov 3rd
parts:
Hola a tothom,
Avui hem decidit canviar la data de la propera reunió al 3 de Nov
(també un dijous). Serà a la mateixa hora i al mateix lloc anunciat
abans- 19:00 al bar Dostrece (veure blog per a un mapa)

També tenim una mini-agenda amb la idea ser d'interés per a tots
nivells farem 2 presentacions planificats:
1) instal·lació d'R (per que no?)- [i si ningú vol, potser una
comparació de IDEs]
2) com fer un package (amb Linux, Windows i Mac !!)
Hi haurà temps per a discusions d'altres temes també, dubtes, etc. A
cada reunió decidirem tots el contingut de la propera reunió, peró
també es pot enviar sugeriments o fer comentaris al blog.

un altre cosa- aviat al blog penjarem un anunci que es pot imprimir i
penjar- Si algú es motiva baixar-lo i fer una mica de distribució. Jo
ya tinc la UAB cobert.

Fins d'aquí un mes!

Tim

#####################################################
Hi all,
Today we decided to change the date for the next (err, first) meeting
to Nov 3rd (also Thursday, same place and time) at 19:00 at the bar
Dostrece (see blog for map).

We also made up a mini agenda, and with the goal of offering something
of interest to both absolute beginners and experienced users are
offering 2 presentations:
1) installing R (why not?) [and if that's a non-issue, then we'll compare IDEs]
2) making packages (under the big 3: Linux, Windows, Mac)
There will time for side discussions, posing general questions,
bringing individual problems to the table. At each meeting we'll vote
on the agenda for the next meeting, so if you're interested in going
straight for big data in parallel or learning how to loop (before
unlearning to loop!) then you better come and let us know!- also make
suggestions here or leave a comment on the blog.

another thing: soon (i.e. tomorrow) we'll hang up a flyer that you can
print out and hang up wherever you want, in case you're motivate to do
a bit of distribution in your area (er, campuses, research centers)-
I've got the UAB covered.

See you in the month!

Tim
